item.title: Free backup for KubeVirt VMs and OpenShift
item.description: Plakar’s Kubernetes integration now backs up KubeVirt VMs: every disk plus the VM manifest, in one consistent snapshot. On OpenShift, a new openshift package keeps restores from doing things you didn’t ask for. Both are free.
